subject: Installation bug report: sfit's cfit on macintosh

messages.author: 4ee2182519091cbd
messages.subject: Installation bug report: sfit's cfit on macintosh
parts:
I also wanted to submit a bug report. I have a Mac with the latest
version of R (upgraded right before aroma installation).

After installation of aroma.affymetrix, I found that the cfit routine
in the sfit library does not install with the correct mod permissions
in

/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/library/sfit/bin/cfit


I changed the permissions on cfit to 755 just to see if it would make
a difference to the error in aroma.affymetrix, and it solved the
problem.

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Installation bug report: sfit's cfit on macintosh
parts:
Hi Deanne,

thanks for letting us know. Just for future troubleshooting, does the
following show the file permissions on OSX:

> library("sfit");
> pathname <- system.file("bin/cfit", package="sfit");
> print(pathname);
> print(file.info(pathname));
> print(file.info(pathname)$mode);

Does the latter show "755" on your updated cfit binary? Then, can you
change the file permission by doing:

> Sys.chmod(pathname, mode="777");
> print(file.info(pathname)$mode);

...and back:

> Sys.chmod(pathname, mode="755");
> print(file.info(pathname)$mode);

I've tried the above on Linux, and there it works. Btw, do you
remember what the default permission was after installation of sfit?

Cheers

/Henrik
